verdict.rationale: The deployment control plane API documents path-based versioning, with endpoints prefixed v1/v2 and version-labelled groups. That covers the versioned-API half of the story. The same evidence states that no standalone deprecation or sunset policy exists for the Agent Server data-plane API, so the deprecation half is not met. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning of the Agent Server data-plane API, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Each endpoint path is prefixed with a version (e.g. `v1`, `v2`)
